The system clock (ICLK) is used as the operating clock of the CPU, DTC, ROM and RAM. \nIt should not exceed 48 MHz.

The Peripheral clock B (PCLKB) is used as the operating clock for CAC, ELC, I/O Ports, KINT, POEG, GPT, AGT, RTC, WDT, IWDT, SCI, I3C, SPI, SSIE, USBFS, USBCC, CRC, ADC12, DOC and TRNG. \nIt should not exceed 32 MHz.

The Peripheral clock D (PCLKD) is used as the operating clock for the GPT (count clock) module, ADC12 (conversion clock) and I3C (Internal operating clock).\nWhen ADC12 is not used PCLKD cannot exceed 64MHz. When ADC12 is used PCLKD must be at least 1MHz and cannot exceed 64MHz.
